speech-ru-16k.wav is a synthetic speech fixture generated by
scripts/create-speech-fixture.cjs using the Windows Microsoft Irina Desktop
text-to-speech voice. It is mono 16-bit PCM at 16 kHz.

Input text:
Здравствуйте. Давайте добавим поиск по номеру заявки. Это тест локального распознавания.

It contains no meeting recording, microphone capture, customer data or model
credentials. Keeping the generated fixture here allows CI to test speech
recognition without requiring a Russian TTS voice on the runner.
